notes.title: New version (v1570) replays / saved games fix
notes.notes:
This patch should fix the replay and save game issues. Saves and replay made BEFORE the “mother of all patches” should work fine as before now, although any save & replay made during the last 48H, since the last patch, won’t work anymore.


Bug fixes :
- Replay from 48H ago fixed.

- Saved games from 48H ago fixed.

- DLC units should have disappeared from the decks of those lucky enough to have them. Sorry folks ...  ;)

- Fixing command points imbalance on Telemark & Dalarna maps.

- Moving some sectors a bit on Upsalla map to make it more even.

- Fixing some spelling errors in Polish & Danish.


Fixing balance errors or changes ommissions
- all sniper rifles RoF increased.

- all interceptors (MiG-31 & F-14) missiles reload time (in the airport) increased by about 20%

- all interceptors (MiG-31 & F-14) angle of fire reduced from 80° to 30°, the plane now needs to face the enemy to fire it's missile.



- all NATO MG3 machine-gun brought to the level of the other MG (displayed RoF unified in the meantime)

- all NATO L23A1 76mm gun ACC increased by +1.

- all NATO HS.820 autocannon ACC increased by +1.

- all NATO MG3 brought back to the level of the other MG (displayed RoF unified in the meantime)

- W-German Panzergrenadier now have their proper G3 ammunition loadout.

- W-German Leo1A5 number of packs fixed from 2 to 1.

- W-German Leo1A5 availability increased from 0.6.4.3.0 to 0.8.6.4.0.

- American M60A1 USMC is now available in Marine decks

- American M2/M3 Bradley 's TOW fixed at AP17 like the other TOW.

- American F-15C number of packs reduced from 2 to 1.

- American V-150 90mm ACC increased by +2.

- American Delta Force's Stoner's moving accuracy penalty removed.

- American F-14 missiles reverted to their old configuration, but with accuracy 6 instead of 7.

- British SAS now use a dedicated Blowpipe weapon with higher accuracy

- British Chieftain Mk.2 ACC increased by +1.

- British Chieftain Mk.5 ACC increased by +1.

- Canadian AVGP Cougar price increased from 20$ to 25$.

- French ERC-90 gun accuracy increased from 6 to 9

- French AML-90 gun accuracy increased from 3 to 6

- French AMX-10RC gun accuracy increased from 8 to 9

- Norwegian M24 gun accuracy increased from 3 to 6

- Norwegian NM116 gun accuracy increased from 5/6 to 8 (PA and HE had different value bug corrected)

- Danish M41 gun accuracy increased from 4 to 7

- Danish M41-DK1 gun accuracy increased from 8 to 10.



- all Pact Strela-10 number of packs fixed from 2 to 1.

- all Pact R-60 missile's rate of fire fixed down to something more reasonable.

- Soviet T-80A number of packs fixed from 2 to 1.

- Soviet PT-85 gun accuracy increased from 8 to 10.

- E-German MiG-21M pilot now drops his bombs on the right place (well at least on the place you told him to)

- E-German AufkPz BRM-1 now uses the late version of the Grom with ACC 5. 

- CSSR BpzV Svatava now uses the late version of the Grom with ACC 5.

- CSSR T-62cz ACC increased by +1.

- Polish Saperzy's RPO now has the [STAT] trait like its Soviet counterpart.



Known issue : there is still a bug with the replay / saved games list, where some saves won't be displayed. We will fix it as well in a next patch, as fast as possible (not today).

notes.title: New version (v1553) aka "Mother of all patch"
notes.notes:
New patch released today.

Log being too long, here are the patch main orientations:

Level design changes (sector, spawn points, air corridor, ...) on several maps, with a focus on 3v3/4v4, in order to:
- fix some that might have been unbalanced.
- favor manoeuver over spam.

 Tanks accuracy scaling came from a time (EE) were ranges were the same for all tanks. With the so-called "heavies" now outranging their lesser brethen, lower ACC was "double penalty" for the latter. Hence we've decided to drastically buff some accuracies: the lesser range, the bigger the buff. By now, from memory, there must not be a tank below ACC 5, and 7 or 8 is the average. Which means that two variants with different ranges may have the same accuracy.

Read more about that here about infantry weapons and speeds.
On the same basis, recon infantry was also reorganized and standardized: although they are always one step faster than their infantry counterparts, recons' quality can easily be spotted as:
- line recon are 5-men strong with now MG.
- shock recon are 5-men strong with a MG or sniper rifle.
- SF recon are 10-men strong with three wepons slots.
- SF snipers are 2-men strong ... but with a buff that compensate for that weakness.  ;) 

Supply vehicles (both land or helo) have been standardized to bring a same amount of supply per card. Besides, FOBs have been made more appealing, while supply vehiles are more scarce. This was meant to make the latter less "one-shot": more supply in the FOB but less supply vehicles per cards mean that one shall be more inclined to spare its suplly vehicle and therefore create a real supply line instead of just calling new supply trucks as reinforcements and let them be once empty ...

Also:
- buffing flamethrower infantry.
- rebalancing nations according to community feedback and taking into account extra-units added after release.
- giving IFV more appeal.
- ...

Detailed log is available on the official forum, here:
http://www.wargame-ee.com/forum/viewtopic.php?f=91&t=36838

notes.title: Wargame: Airland Battle Update Now Available
notes.notes:
VOX POPULI, the first free DLC from Wargame AirLand Battle, has been developed specifically to respond to the demands of the community… and has just landed with a whole arsenal of new features!

“CONQUEST” mode makes a great comeback in Multiplayer mode and against the AI, offering a range of new objectives to commanders all over the world. Unlike DESTRUCTION mode, victory in CONQUEST doesn’t depend on the destruction of the enemy forces, but on your ability to capture and hold more territory than your opponent. All the existing maps in Multiplayer are of course playable in this mode.

In addition to this new game mode, CAMPAIGN, already playable in Versus mode, is now available in CO-OPERATIVE mode and allows you to join forces with a friend to play any campaign against the AI. 

In Skirmish mode you can now select the type and nationality of the equipment of any AI opponent. Last but not least, we have introduced 24 new units and 5 new maps (playable in Destruction and Conquest modes) for even more frenzied multiplayer contests!
Play the brand new CONQUEST mode
CAMPAIGN mode playable as a Co-op game
